name: Temporal
description:
Upscaling, anti-aliasing and frame generation for Minecraft. Renders the world at a lower resolution and upscales it with NVIDIA DLSS, AMD FSR 3, NIS or FSR 1, keeping the HUD at full resolution; temporal anti-aliasing (TAA, DLAA, FSR Native AA); and frame generation (NVIDIA DLSS Frame Generation 2x-6x, AMD FSR 3 Frame Generation 2x).

Uses NVIDIA DLSS, DLSS Frame Generation and Reflex, and AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution. NVIDIA, DLSS and Reflex are trademarks of NVIDIA Corporation; AMD, FidelityFX and FSR are trademarks of Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.
